policy: Exact named tests are narrow evidence. Implementation remains independently reviewed; live suites and external onboarding cannot be inferred from unit outcomes. See GAP-AUDIT.md.

CONC-07.limits: Cooperative FIFO applies to live clients retrying within the two-second lease. Registry-lock contention may return unqueued BUSY; no operation is queued or replayed. Not scheduler fairness or exclusion of human input.

ENV-10.limits: Unit checks cover atomic backend replacement and old-cache disposal. Separate live_mcp_reconnect suite supplies private actual XFCE/display/bus restart evidence; fresh Silo VM behavior remains external.

LIFE-07.limits: Injected Linux boottime/monotonic offset change verifies invalidation; actual VM suspend and host resume remain unqualified.

LIFE-09.limits: Injected ENOSPC/fsync errors preserve existing selection and metadata. Does not cover every runtime allocation, sudden power loss, or actual guest filesystem exhaustion.

MCP-04.limits: Advertised JSON schemas validate before FastMCP coercion. Booleans-as-numbers, string booleans, unknown arguments and malformed arrays are refused; separate live MCP suite checks real transport and unchanged field state.

OBS-09.limits: 32-million-native-pixel preflight and 2560-pixel returned edge limit. Not a measured process-wide memory ceiling.

AUTH-09.limits: Selected-session login1/screensaver hints are checked before public mutations. Positive lock/screensaver hints and probe timeout block input; observation/recovery remain available. Unknown/inactive is not proof of unlocked state, and no atomic lock-to-input guarantee is claimed. Real private session-input fixture evidence is separate.

WAIT-02.limits: Fresh bounded accessibility-tree predicates; provider completeness remains explicit. Live delayed GTK cases are separate evidence.

WAIT-05.limits: Sampled client pixels can establish sampled visual stability only, not application idleness, data persistence or completion of every animation.

PERF-07.limits: Filtered/paginated public window output with explicit counts; internal targets remain complete. Actual 512-resource helper capacity was tested separately; thousands of managed app windows remain unqualified.

PERF-10.limits: Subprocess output, queue/caches and descriptor cleanup have bounded regression coverage. Short live_resource_stress is separate; this is not hours-long endurance or an OS resource guarantee. Actual disposable child RLIMIT_NOFILE and RLIMIT_AS failures are bounded and redacted; post-spawn uncertainty and cancellation priority are preserved. These do not establish host-wide RAM/CPU pressure behavior.

SEC-08.limits: These tests validate the evaluator, not the agent. One actual fresh-agent adversarial-application task passed separately; not broad prompt-injection resistance.

KEY-03.limits: Current-group named-symbol planning; native US/French/Russian probes documented separately. Arbitrary custom XKB actions and dead keys remain outside qualified behavior.

KEY-04.limits: Unavailable symbols refuse without changing layout. Actual French and Russian-group behavior has separate live evidence; not every keyboard layout.

KEY-05.limits: Unit Caps-Lock case/shortcut planning; real Caps/Num state preservation checked separately by live keyboard oracle.

KEY-06.limits: Preheld keys/buttons and latched state refuse. Human input can race after preflight; X11 cannot distinguish a human concurrently holding the same planned input.

KEY-08.limits: Unit ownership/recovery invariants. Actual stopped injector, controller death, guardian failure and same-display replacement have separate private live evidence; dead/unreachable server cleanup remains uncertain.

FAULT-10.limits: Owned drag injector cleanup and pending ownership contracts. Actual killed-controller/stopped-injector and replacement-session tests are separate; abrupt whole-VM loss cannot return a final tool result.

PTR-03.limits: Hover/initial movement refuses preheld input before movement. Human races after preflight remain possible; tooltip content/timing is application-specific.

OBS-11.limits: Eight fixed Pango samples only; coverage is advisory and never proves universal Unicode or actual application typography. Mock failure/cancellation/readiness contracts plus separate real installed/restricted-font evidence in live_font_diagnostic.py; this map records only unit outcomes.

OBS-08.limits: Synthetic valid black PNG and missing/invalid/truncated capture payloads verify black pixels remain valid and failures create no snapshot. No assertion that a valid black screenshot proves the application is healthy.

KEY-09.limits: Bounded integer count 1..20 validated before target lookup/helper launch and propagated into native planning. Unit preflight/plan contract; repeated delivery and interruption have separate private live keyboard evidence.

SEM-09.limits: Observed target identity includes bounded complete name, provider connection and authenticated accessibility bus generation. Colliding/reused paths, bus changes and post-selection meaning changes are refused or uncertain. Identical complete provider identities cannot distinguish every reused widget, and cross-process provider calls are not atomic.

DATA-01.limits: Current TableCell identity and viewport are checked; at most one same-column anchor per prior selected row is read, bounded to 500 selected rows. Missing anchors refuse before mutation; replacement or changed meaning cannot verify success. No automatic scroll/reacquire or general virtualized-grid support.

DATA-02.limits: Mock reordering/replacement of target and retained selection identities returns stale or uncertain results. Separate real GTK sorting/filtering evidence exists; no automatic record reacquisition or universal stable-record identity.

SEM-01.limits: A sole cached observed action can be invoked without guessing its toolkit name; multiple actions require explicit choice and unobserved actions are refused. Mock tests do not verify application completion.

ENV-08.limits: Authenticated AT-SPI bus GUID failure/change refuses old target traversal; reconnect validates the selected environment and preserves the old backend if the candidate bus fails. Mock native/provider contracts do not establish every session D-Bus outage or automatic application bridge reconnection. Private live_bus_generation.py is separate evidence.

LIFE-06.limits: Controlled backend replacement and closed-cache invalidation only. This is narrower than restarting an entire MCP process and reconnecting every client; accessibility bus replacement is mapped separately under ENV-08.

ERR-08.limits: Unexpected failures return fixed INTERNAL_ERROR diagnostics with operation ID and uncertain effect. Gate release permits recovery only when no separate unfinished cleanup owner remains. These deterministic error paths do not prove all native failure modes recover.

ENV-03.limits: Mocked account/syscall launcher checks ordering and environment allowlist; does not exercise real root SSH transport or prove a launched GUI process identity.

ENV-04.limits: Mocked same-account launch verifies exec without privilege syscalls; real fresh SSH attachment is separate evidence.

ENV-05.limits: Synthetic proc tree discovers DISPLAY=:7 with its session bus, rejects incomplete environments and refuses fallback for a missing explicit PID. No actual SSH environment is exercised.

ENV-07.limits: Only missing authority-file preflight is asserted using a mocked filesystem check; stale cookies, real X authentication rejection and cookie-redaction failures are not covered by this method.

ENV-09.limits: Mocked discovery and elapsed clock establish retry/bounded failure; not a fresh desktop service startup timing measurement.

DIAG-02.limits: Doctor rejects malformed/negative mocked provider replies and redacts them. This does not qualify actual bus activation, provider hangs or all toolkit capabilities.

DIAG-03.limits: Synthetic capability reports distinguish observation, semantics, keyboard, topology and blocked mutations; provider success retains application-dependent editing. These are classification assertions, not actual missing-dependency environments.

WIN-02.limits: Synthetic same-PID accessibility trees with colliding names/paths verify selected-root/provider scoping and stale refusal. Does not establish all real multi-window toolkit mappings.

WIN-09.limits: Mocked recycled activation target rejects original generation; failed post-dispatch lookup stays uncertain; disappearing enumeration race has bounded retries. No atomic guarantee against asynchronous window-manager target closure.

DIAG-10.limits: Read-only MCP and actual fresh-process CLI sanitized JSON export: strict health/version/history whitelist, injected and malformed diagnostic privacy, exception suppression, bounded prior-operation snapshot and no report-file creation. Free-text reproduction steps are supplied separately, never retained; no replay, upload, earlier-process CLI history, fresh Mac/SSH or all-provider qualification. Actual guest MCP application invariance is separate live evidence.

SHIP-08.limits: Driver version, canonical actual tools/list identity, editable and installed bundled-skill bytes, malformed or unavailable artifacts, and shared CLI/public doctor identity path. The bundled artifact hash does not identify the skill loaded by an agent; no automatic plugin cache invalidation, schema migration or fresh Mac/SSH compatibility qualification.

WAY-01.limits: Explicit unsupported-session refusal before handler/input; diagnostics remain available. Actual private Weston and stdio MCP refusal evidence is recorded in WAYLAND-BASELINE.md. No native Wayland backend or universal compositor qualification.

WAY-05.limits: XWAYLAND protocol-extension rejection prevents treating Xwayland access as native Wayland support; native X11 remains available despite stale hints. Actual Weston/Xwayland and native Xvfb evidence is recorded in WAYLAND-BASELINE.md. Older servers without the extension and other compositors are not qualified.
